tools.name: search_finch_agents
tools.description: Search the Finch marketplace of third-party AI agents by task (e.g. 'trace stolen crypto', 'wallet risk', 'covered call', 'tailor resume', 'Singapore condo'). Returns each agent's official summary, price, and a run link.

tools.name: get_finch_agent
tools.description: Get the full official description, price and run link of one Finch agent by its slug (from search_finch_agents).

tools.name: how_to_call_finch_agents
tools.description: Steps for the user to run a Finch agent: in the browser (fastest) or by connecting the authenticated Finch MCP server to this assistant.

tools.name: trace_crypto_funds
tools.description: Trace where crypto funds went from a wallet address or transaction hash (fund flows, transaction relationships), using MistTrack by SlowMist on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: check_wallet_address_risk
tools.description: Check the risk of a crypto wallet address or transaction with MistTrack by SlowMist on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: analyze_hyperliquid_us_stock_perp
tools.description: Analyze U.S. equity perpetuals on Hyperliquid: trend, volume, open interest, funding rate and news, using Maneki AI on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: screen_wheel_strategy_options
tools.description: Screen cash-secured puts or covered calls on a US stock (options expiring in 3 to 9 days) and get an OPEN or SKIP decision, using the Wheel-strategy Option Desk on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: compare_sector_returns_vs_sp500
tools.description: Compare sector or asset returns and volatility against the S&P 500 from public financial data, using Powerdrill Finance Data Agent on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: monitor_market_trading_setups
tools.description: Report market conditions and potential trading setups for forex, crypto or stocks, using TrainFlow Nexus on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: assess_onchain_business
tools.description: Assess an on-chain business from verifiable operating data (token usage, revenue, customer signals) with an evidence-backed risk grade, using FlowCredit on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: analyze_singapore_condo
tools.description: Analyze Singapore private residential property (condos, apartments, ECs): price trends, rental yields, project and district comparisons, using ChatProperty on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: tailor_resume_to_job
tools.description: Tailor a resume to a job description with ATS keyword-match analysis, write a cover letter, or prepare for interviews, using LittlePinkPotato on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: find_job_openings
tools.description: Find recent job openings (Singapore, China, Hong Kong, Australia, US, Canada, remote) ranked by fit, using LittlePinkPotato on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: research_brief_science_health
tools.description: Get a cited research brief from scientific papers, clinical trial records, drug and compound data, using Powerdrill Science & Health Research Agent on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: debug_or_review_code
tools.description: Debug code, write code, review implementations or produce technical documentation, using SuperClaw on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: audit_website_for_growth
tools.description: Audit a website's market positioning, messaging and conversion for global customer acquisition, using SPARK on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.

tools.name: book_appointment_by_phone
tools.description: Have an AI place a real phone call to a restaurant, salon, clinic or hotel to book, reschedule or ask a question, using LifeClaw on Finch. Returns the agent's official description, price, free runs, a run link and a ready-to-send request.
